headline: J&J's MedTech Performance Slows in Q2: Will Sales Improve in H2?
summary: J&J's MedTech growth slowed down in Q2 as Cardiovascular lagged, but new product launches and stronger Vision, Surgery and Orthopedics may lift H2 sales.

headline: Oppenheimer Maintains Outperform on Boston Scientific, Lowers Price Target to $85
summary: Oppenheimer  analyst Suraj Kalia   maintains Boston Scientific (NYSE:BSX) with a Outperform and lowers the price target from $90 to $85.
